root.label: Kentucky Supreme Court rules against shrine zoning variance

events.label: Kentucky Supreme Court rules against shrine zoning variance

slots.name: RLUIPA infringement finding
slots.sentence: Affirming that ruling, the Kentucky Supreme Court said the ordinance did not substantially infringe on the church’s rights because it could construct a smaller shrine on its existing plot.

slots.name: Kentucky Supreme Court ruling date
slots.sentence: The state's highest court concluded last December that a zoning board in Park Hills, Kentucky, a suburb of Cincinnati, didn't have the authority to grant a variance for the church's owner to build the shrine on a residential tract.

slots.name: trial court ruling status
slots.sentence: A state judge sided with the church

slots.name: Court of Appeals ruling status
slots.sentence: the Kentucky Court of Appeals reversed.
